description: The last giant king's Kingsword cut down to a living giant's two hands at a forge of the colossi, its notched edge drawn out again and its grip bound in links of his oath-chain. It rings when it strikes, as his shell rang: its heavy blow sends a ring of force out round what it hits. It fits stages 7 to 10.

perk.text: The heavy rings: a 4 m ring of force round what it strikes
